text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The general directorate of ports is to be leased to the private sector.
- Two Bahraini tug boat crewmen were rescued when their vessel capsized on Saturday while pulling a ship out to sea from Bapco pier.
- Investment opportunities in Bahrain attract Indian nationals.
- Bahrain's emir and prime minister praised King Fahd's role in boosting relations between Gulf Arab states.
